author: Original models authored for Les Royaumes de l’Éclipse

lame.status: third production: CC0 animation retarget and measured motion calibration; artistic review ongoing

motion_calibration.source: Quaternius Universal Animation Library Standard CC0

lame.weapon_socket: weaponGrip, blade_base and blade_tip; all previous rest joints retained
lame.cloth_skinning: front panels 85%+ pelvis; gravity-oriented and crouch-compressed cape joints, no cloth simulation
lame.art_scope: Original geometry and materials; seven retargeted CC0 Quaternius animations, remaining actions authored in the base generator
